correctness.rationale: The exact Jacobian has distinct negative real eigenvalues; the exact convolution kernel and node harmonic response follow by diagonalization. A uniform Hurwitz semigroup bootstrap yields a frequency-independent \(O(A^2)\) all-time error in the smooth first region. A proved strict frozen overshoot bound below 0.09, the exact \(u_1(2)<-31/320<-0.09\) inequality, and explicit low/high bounds yield all three regimes for sufficiently small A. The prey and predator fields on the below-threshold branches strictly decay. The possibility of tangential first contact is addressed by asserting only an admissible Filippov continuation, not global uniqueness. Symbolic identities and illustrative trajectories were checked with the standalone source file.

value.rationale: The target paper interprets its mechanism using a nonzero damped natural frequency. An explicit strict node whose prey transfer gain peaks at a positive frequency, and whose periodic forcing alone crosses an irreversible extinction switch while all frozen and distant-frequency forcings do not, supplies a nonroutine structural boundary on that interpretation. The threshold is selected between rigorously separated static and resonant response sizes, not picked as an arbitrary numerical invariant.
